mappings.before: description: An inspired interpretation of Supabaze's design language — an open-source database platform built on a clean white-and-near-black system with a single signature emerald-green CTA, a custom humanist sans display tier, and dense product UI mockups composited above the hero. The brand reads as quietly technical: minimal chrome, a near-monochrome palette, and the green primary acting as the only chromatic event on the page.
